title: SLC7A11 in liver tissue homeostasis and disease: Cellular mechanisms linking ferroptosis, redox regulation, and hepatic cell survival.
snippet: Liver diseases involve major disturbances in iron metabolism, redox homeostasis, and lipid peroxidation; therefore, ferroptosis is considered as an important link between cellular stress and liver damage/progression.
